svg.title: Hit Count: probe, count, keep the top heads
svg.text: Hit Count: probe, count, keep the top heads
toy: 6 heads, 5 probes, the 11-token prompt of the attention-row figure
per head: argmax position on each probe, and the hit counter

g.text: Hit rule for CS728 (the tool version of the copy rule): a head hits if its argmax lands inside the CORRECT tool's span.
P1 wants B (3–4). L0H2, L1H0 look at 3 and L1H2 at 4: three hits. L0H0 looks at <s>, L0H1 and L1H1 at the query.
P4 wants D (7–8). L1H0 (7) and L1H1 (8) hit; L1H2 looks at the query (9).
P5 wants B again. Only L1H0 (4) and L1H2 (3) hit.
Sort by hits: L1H0 = 5, L1H2 = 4, L0H2 = 2, … Keep the top k (k = 2 here; your project kept the top 10).
L0H0 never hits: it always looks at <s> (the sink). Counting hits filters such heads out without any training.
